key_insight: Agnostic learning and generating outputs indistinguishable from real data by a model class are computationally equivalent via efficient oracle reductions.
engineering_relevance: The result identifies multiaccuracy as a reusable theoretical primitive for agnostic learning and broader learning objectives.
method: Prove the previously missing reduction from agnostic learning to a multiaccuracy oracle.
Make adaptive oracle queries while modifying the label distribution and aggregating predictions.
Use a connection to online no-regret learning and follow-the-leader algorithms.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical proofs of efficient reductions, not empirical datasets or benchmark results.
watch_item: The constructions require adaptive oracle access; post-processing a single multiaccurate predictor is insufficient even for weak forms of learning.
